about:
American Steel Works is an owner-operated welding and fabrication shop based in West Warwick, Rhode Island. Founded in 2018 by Giovanni Colasante, the business began as a service-focused operation built on direct customer relationships and field experience.

The shop provides welding of practically any weldable material using almost any process, custom fabrication to engineered drawings, and mobile welding services that bring equipment to the customer's site. The facility handles projects ranging from one-off custom parts to production runs, though specific floor space, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers include aerospace manufacturers needing critical aircraft components, as well as general industrial clients requiring custom metalwork and production support. The company emphasizes service across both prototype and production quantities.

American Steel Works differentiates itself through personal service, precise attention to detail on every job, competitive pricing, and the flexibility of on-site welding. The owner-operator model aims to keep communication direct and turnaround responsive.
